navaid.name: USCGC Aspen
navaid.description: A sea going buoy tender with a crew of 49; ASPEN is responsible for 76 California buoys from the Mexican border to the Oregon border. She is capable of ice breaking and missions like search and rescue, law enforcement, and marine environmental protection.
